name: AlGhafa-Arabic-LLM-Benchmark-Native-10percent
description: AlGhafa-Arabic-LLM-Benchmark-Native-10percent is an Arabic-language evaluation suite designed to measure LLM performance on tasks reflecting native Arabic usage and variety. It includes tasks that probe comprehension, generation, and classification in Arabic to assess both accuracy and naturalness of model outputs. The dataset/split labeled "Native-10percent" emphasizes evaluation on examples representative of native-speaker distributions.
reputation: A regionally focused Arabic benchmark with growing adoption among Arabic NLP researchers but limited broad community exposure compared to major multilingual suites.
